Start with the project's purpose and the choices due over the next year.
For each choice, identify the evidence already available, the additional work
that could change it, and when that work must reach the decision maker.

The overview also records where modeling or critical thinking could help:
framing the question, exposing an assumption, comparing options, or designing
a study that resolves a consequential uncertainty.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). Purpose, scope and how to judge
  whether the template helps.
- [Planning worksheet](planning-template.qmd). Copyable fields, a decision
  register, evidence planning and a worked example.
- [One-slide overview](overview.qmd). Editable PowerPoint template, preview

- [References and origins](references.qmd). The source of the structure and
  its relationship to the existing dose-finding strategy project.
